title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, add one line of trace metadata so an unexamined staged fil
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, add one line of trace metadata so an unexamined staged file can be named rather than only counted.

Find this exact line:
          examination_by_extension: composeExamination?.by_extension ?? null,

Insert immediately after it a new line at the same indentation:
          examination_unexamined_files: composeExamination?.unexamined.slice(0, 20) ?? null,

That is the entire change. Do not modify any other line and do not touch any other file. The unexamined field is already a string array on the same object the adjacent lines read .length from, so no new computation, import, or type is needed. Reason: rung 2 of the operational_state ladder reports a nonzero unexamined count with by_extension .t equal to 1, a truncated path, and the count alone gives no way to identify which file it was.
